entities.name: Nicolás Méndez

entities.summary: Nicolás Marcelo Méndez is an Argentine volleyball player, member of the Argentina men's national volleyball team and French club Paris Volley, participant of the Olympic Games,. His father, Marcelo Méndez, is the current head coach of the Argentine national team.
